description: Future fill-in packet for the leading CKM heavy-link gate. Replace every null with selected no-proxy data before running scripts/compute_ckm_heavy_link_gate.py.

phase_branch.branch_convention: selected chi_79 branch unless a later selected orientation convention chooses the conjugate branch

u.meaning: t_u=(T_u13,T_u23), aggregate of selected character-trivial channel heavy-link entries

d.meaning: t_d=(T_d13,T_d23), aggregate of selected character-trivial channel heavy-link entries

u.meaning: c_u=(C_u13,C_u23), selected C6 amplitude-support heavy-link entries

d.meaning: c_d=(C_d13,C_d23), selected C6 amplitude-support heavy-link entries

required_no_proxy_sources: selected primitive C1/C3/C4/C7 or other character-trivial support for t_u,t_d
selected C6 amplitude-support matrices for c_u,c_d
selected branch orientation if the conjugate q79 branch is used
normalization convention compatible with the rank-one E33 seed
forbidden_fill_sources: observed CKM phase or Jarlskog invariant
post-hoc threshold factors fitted to flavor output
arbitrary entry-wise phases outside the q79 C6 restriction
